products.title: Waterboy Hydration Bottle - 17oz (500ml), Matte Blue
products.body_html:
Your daily hydration, upgraded. The Waterboy Bottle holds 17oz (500ml), sized for your desk, gym bag, car cupholder and carry-on.

Fill it up, tear open a Waterboy hydration stick (0g sugar, big on electrolytes), shake and go. It's the easiest way to make hydration a habit.

Why you'll love it

  • The right size: 17oz / 500ml, easy to refill and easy to carry.
  • Matte blue finish: with the white WaterBoy script logo.
  • Easy to carry: screw-top cap and a slim profile that fits most cupholders.
  • Made for Waterboy: pairs with any Waterboy electrolyte stick.

Details

  • Capacity: 17oz / 500ml
  • Color: Matte blue
  • Logo: White WaterBoy script

products.title: Classics Ribbed Tank
products.body_html:

Size & Fit:

Care Instructions:
